what: Principal Financial Group manages retirement plans, mainly for small and medium-sized American employers, and runs an asset manager and an international insurance business across Latin America and Asia.
customers: Small and mid-sized employers offering retirement plans, individual savers, and institutional investors in its funds.
money: group life, disability and dental insurance
moat: Relationships with tens of thousands of small employers, which are expensive for competitors to win one at a time but very sticky once established.
risks: Revenue fell about 3% last year and about 4% a year over three years
Fee income falls when markets fall
Asset management has seen industry-wide outflows
Analyst targets imply the shares are roughly fairly valued
opportunities: A dividend yield around 3% with consistent buybacks
Small business retirement plan coverage is expanding under state mandates
Group benefits revenue grows with employment and wages
watch: Retirement plan net cash flows and asset management net flows.
